summary: Axe Compute Inc. (NASDAQ: AGPU, formerly Predictive Oncology) filed an 8-K disclosing a September 11, 2026 Stock Purchase Agreement to sell wholly owned subsidiary Helomics Corporation to DataMeds AI, Inc. (NASDAQ: MEDS). Consideration comprises 636,328 MEDS shares, 19.99% of DataMeds pre-closing outstanding stock, plus a $1,363,672 convertible note at $1.00 per share. The equity and note carry a 12-month lock-up and piggyback registration rights; Axe also assumed remaining Pittsburgh lease rent and a non-compete. Closing completed the transition to pure-play neocloud GPU-as-a-Service. Watch MEDS share performance, note conversion and lock-up expiry overhang.
